experiments.prediction: Project executed selected-edge counts to a directed capacity graph. Compute maximum flow between the selected source and sink slots, recover the minimum partition, and compare its crossing capacity with the flow.
experiments.explanation: Change source and sink and inspect the edges supplying capacity. Max-flow/min-cut is an exact finite graph identity here. Equating this capacity to quantum entropy requires an independently defined quantum state and entropy measurement.
experiments.validation: Minimum cut versus independently evaluated competitors.

experiments.title: Recorded distribution stationarity
experiments.question: Does the measured distribution settle over the available run?
experiments.prediction: Fix position histogram bins using the training prefix, then plot frame entropy, distance to the pooled training distribution, and successive-frame distance. Retain eligible counts.
experiments.explanation: Extend the trajectory and compare separate seeds. Slow drift or small frame differences are observations to quantify; the experiment does not insert a stationary distribution or substitute eligible-slot fraction for trajectory survival probability.
experiments.validation: Killed-chain evolution and normalized observables.

experiments.title: Measured fitness curvature scale
experiments.question: Does the local Ricci tensor resemble constant curvature?
experiments.prediction: Reconstruct actual conditional fitness curvature, report scalar curvature and its absolute scalar-derived radius, and compare Ricci with scalar curvature times the metric divided by dimension.
experiments.explanation: Inspect the Ricci isotropy residual alongside the radius. A scalar radius compresses one tensor contraction; it does not establish constant curvature, an AdS geometry, or a cosmological constant.
experiments.validation: Exact geometric quantities versus local expansions.

experiments.title: Scale evolution of the executed cloud
experiments.question: What expansion history does the actual population produce?
experiments.prediction: Measure the covariance volume scale and its finite-step log-volume expansion from recorded eligible positions, with the covariance ridge and stage budget exported.
experiments.explanation: Change viscosity or memory and compare the resulting histories. The scale is computed from the swarm at each time. Its evolution is measured rather than generated by an imposed cosmological expansion equation.
experiments.validation: Scale-factor differentiation and Raychaudhuri terms.

experiments.title: Information in executed region-to-region interactions
experiments.question: How informative is an interaction source region about its target?
experiments.prediction: Form the joint distribution of source and target region labels using actual selected-edge counts. Compute marginal and joint entropies, conditional target entropy, mutual information, and the information chain-rule residual.
experiments.explanation: Move the partition and inspect the four joint frequencies. This classical empirical edge statistic characterizes the selected interaction pattern; predictive information across time needs a time-indexed observable comparison.
experiments.validation: Exact joint-law enumeration and conditional entropy.

experiments.title: Held-out empirical field closure
experiments.question: Does iterating a measured descriptor channel predict later states?
experiments.prediction: Fit a pseudocount-regularized transition matrix for whole-frame mean position on the training prefix. Compare one-step and iterated two-step predictions with a training-marginal baseline on the chronological suffix.
experiments.explanation: Change bins and pseudocount and compare the losses. A successful one-step fit need not retain the donor history or unresolved fields needed for two-step prediction. Empty held-out support remains an explicit coverage outcome.
experiments.validation: Full semigroup versus reduced semigroup evolution.

experiments.title: Dimensionless scales measured from the gas
experiments.question: How large is one algorithmic step in the run's own units?
experiments.prediction: Measure an RMS covariance length and speed, form their crossing time, and report timestep times speed divided by length alongside eligible fraction. Export scale degeneracy when a required denominator vanishes.
experiments.explanation: Compare configurations in these measured units while retaining their raw quantities. These are empirical gas scales; no external particle-mass anchor or physical cosmological scale enters their construction.
experiments.validation: Dimensional conversion and stress reconstruction.
